title: Global Online Distribution of the Nine TCM Body Constitutions (Wang Qi / CACM Framework): Aggregate Dataset From 21,242 Assessments (2026)
description:
Anonymized aggregate statistical dataset from 21,242 completed 29-question Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) body constitution assessments (14,104 unique respondents across 164 countries and regions, collected 2026-03-17 to 2026-11-18), scored under the official China Association of Chinese Medicine (CACM Standard ZYYXH/T157-2009, Professor Wang Qi nine-constitution model).

Includes 5 aggregate CSV tables (overall distribution, gender cross-tabulation, adult age-band stratification, top 15 dual near-tie mixed constitution pairs, and country summary for n ≥ 50) plus a full Methodology & Cohort Limitations Note (PDF). Zero personally identifiable information (PII) is included.

Live daily source of record: https://www.identifytcm.com/constitution-statistics | Framework overview: https://www.identifytcm.com/constitution
